_: The camera's knobs (camera_rig.gd reads them; one owner). floor: the closest the lens comes, a low oblique just over the roofs (Mac: no close-up realism). go_to: the distance each kind of 'go to X' frames at (the one framing rule, camera_rig.go_to; Anno 1800 / Manor Lords jump). sight_steps: how many headings either way go_to tries before taking the least blocked. near_fade: what stands right in front of the lens dissolves (Godot's dithered distance fade; Anno 1800 / Manor Lords): gone nearer than 'gone', whole from 'solid', in game units from the lens; buildings, trees and a castle's walls each (a castle's go sooner: wide and tall, at roof height they would fill the foreground).

shots._: The director's own shots (director.gd; the professional audit: one gate-and-banner framing reused for every scene): each new shot turns from the last by one of these (radians), never the same turn twice running, and its distance varies by up to this share either way. The sight rule (sight_steps) still has the last word.

town_shot._: A town's square framed for a still (the shot harness's --city; camera_rig.square_view; art target 01-town): away_from_castle (1: the lens on the far side of the square from the castle, so the castle stands behind it; 0: the old fixed heading), turn (radians off that line, so the castle sits to one side), card_shift (the square set right of the middle by this share of the distance, clear of the town card on the left).
